gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Approachable is the body here, with Noto Sans PhagsPa leaving its c openings clear enough to see through, while Plakkaat stays closed and bold. And that gap is the pair's best quality: rod-stock heaviness up top, breathing room below.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-phoenic: Thick, tight, and a bit stubborn, Plakkaat curls its terminals almost back onto the stem. Then Noto Sans Phoenician steps in with generous lowercase and s curves that open wide, so the closed heading and open body each get their own space.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-psalter: Plakkaat hits like a stamped sign, heavy and rounded with terminals that nearly loop shut. But Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi, with gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals, probably wants a modest size next to it so the heading doesn't swamp it.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Professional in tone but wide open in detail, Noto Sans Rejang gives its lowercase counters the look of glass portholes beside the heavy Plakkaat. Paragraphs of it stay light and legible.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-runic: Chunky curls meet roomy lowercase: Plakkaat's closed, bent-straw letters sit above Noto Sans Runic, whose big x-height and unclosed curves feel plain sans. One feels sealed, the other open.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-samarit: Approachable describes Noto Sans Samaritan, with daylight inside its curves and a hefty lowercase body. Yet Plakkaat does the loud work, heavy and bent-straw round, while the body simply carries the words.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-saurash: Noto Sans Saurashtra reads clean and unfussy, its capitals barely taller than their neighbors and its counters staying connected to the outside. Against Plakkaat's closed, heavy loops it feels like an open window.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads like chalk curves that stop well short of closing, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Beside Plakkaat's closed, stylus-width lines, Noto Sans SC would keep a long passage loose and easy going.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Plakkaat's terminals sweep around until they nearly touch the stem, a tight, heavy curl. Noto Sans Sharada leaves its c forms open and its lowercase bulky, so a long passage feels sturdy and unhurried.
